G0200.strongs: a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation)

G0202.strongs: apparently an intensive of); a hearer (merely)

G0203.root: from [[w:G0206]] and probably a modified form of πόσθη (the penis or male sexual organ)
G0203.strongs: the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person
senses: (perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: [[r:ACT.11.3|Act 11:3]], [[r:ROM.2.25|Rom 2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12]], [[r:1CO.7.18|1Co 7:18-19]], [[r:GAL.5.6|Gal 5:6 6:15]], [[r:COL.2.13|Col 2:13 3:11]] By meton., the uncircumcised: [[r:ROM.4.9|Rom 4:9]], [[r:GAL.2.7|Gal 2:7]], [[r:EPH.2.11|Eph 2:11]].† (AS)

ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον (ἄκροι, γωνία, an angle) = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word ἀ.), at the extreme angle: ὁ ἀ., the corner foundation stone, [[r:EPH.2.20|Eph 2:20]], [[r:1PE.2.6|1Pe 2:6]].† (AS)

G0205.strongs: properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty
senses: (ἄκρος, θίς, a heap), prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl.,
In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): [[r:HEB.7.4|Heb 7:4.]] † (AS)

G0206.root: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of [[w:G0188]]
G0206.kjv: one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle
senses: ἄκρος, -α, -ον highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: [[r:MRK.13.27|Mrk 13:27]], [[r:LUK.16.24|Luk 16:24]], [[r:HEB.11.21|Heb 11:21]]; pl. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), [[r:MAT.24.31|Mat 24:31.]]† (AS)

G0207.forms: Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.)

G0209.root: adverb from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G2967]]
G0209.strongs: in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely
senses: ἀκωλύτως adv. (κωλύω), without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:ACT.28.31|Act 28:31.]]† (AS)

G0211.forms: ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος)
G0211.root: neuter of ἀλάβαστρος (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone
G0211.strongs: properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material)
senses: a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: [[r:MAT.26.7|Mat 26:7]], [[r:MRK.14.3|Mrk 14:3]], [[r:LUK.7.37|Luk 7:37]] (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ (ἀλαζών), the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: [[r:JAS.4.16|Jas 4:16]] (Mayor, in l), [[r:1JN.2.16|1Jn 2:16.]]† (AS)
(ἄλη, wandering) prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: [[r:ROM.1.30|Rom 1:30]], [[r:2TI.3.2|2Ti 3:2]].† SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G0214.strongs: to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang
senses: (onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail: [[r:MRK.5.38|Mrk 5:38]] (cf. [[r:JER.4.8|Jer 4:8]]); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), [[r:1CO.13.1|1Co 13:1]] (cf. ὀλολύζω).† (AS)

G0215.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G2980]]

G0217.forms: ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word)
senses: salt, lit, and figuratively: [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13]], [[r:MRK.9.50|Mrk 9:50]] [[r:LUK.14.34|Luk 14:34]]; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: [[r:COL.4.6|Col 4:6.]]† (AS)

G0218.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as particle of union) and the base of [[w:G3045]]
senses: (cf. λίπος, oil), to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), [[r:MAT.6.17|Mat 6:17]], [[r:JHN.12.3|Jhn 12:3]], [[r:MRK.16.1|Mrk 16:1]]; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, [[r:MRK.6.13|Mrk 6:13]], [[r:JAS.5.14|Jas 5:14]]; μύρῳ, [[r:LUK.7.38|Luk 7:38, 46]], [[r:JHN.11.2|Jhn 11:2]].† SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.) (AS)
(ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή), cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: [[r:MRK.13.35|Mrk 13:35.]]† (AS)

G0221.strongs: an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria

G0223.root: from the same as (the first part of) [[w:G0220]] and [[w:G0435]]
G0223.strongs: man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man
senses: Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): [[r:2TI.4.14|2Ti 4:14.]] † (AS)

Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" (Cremer, 86): [[r:ROM.9.1|Rom 9:1]], al.; of religious truth, [[r:ROM.1.25|Rom 1:25]], al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, [[r:GAL.2.5|Gal 2:5]], al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.15.8|Rom 15:8.]]
Subjectively, truthfulness, truth, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: [[r:JHN.8.44|Jhn 8:44]], 3Jo 3.

In phrases (MM, VGT, see word): ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας, [[r:MRK.12.14|Mrk 12:14]], al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), [[r:ROM.9.1|Rom 9:1]], [[r:2CO.12.6|2Co 12:6]], [[r:EPH.4.25|Eph 4:25]], al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν, [[r:JHN.3.21|Jhn 3:21]], [[r:1JN.1.6|1Jn 1:6]] (cf. DB, iv, 818b, ff.). (AS)

G0226.strongs: to be true (in doctrine and profession)
senses: (ἀληθής), to speak the truth (R, mg., deal truly; Field, Notes, 192): [[r:GAL.4.16|Gal 4:16]], [[r:EPH.4.15|Eph 4:15]].† (AS)
(λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real),

of persons, truthful: [[r:MAT.22.16|Mat 22:16]], [[r:MRK.12.14|Mrk 12:14]], [[r:JHN.3.33|Jhn 3:33 7:18 8:26]], [[r:ROM.3.4|Rom 3:4]], [[r:2CO.6.8|2Co 6:8]].† SYN.: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., Syn., § viii; Cremer, 84 f., 631 Abbott, JV, 234 f.; DB, iv, 818 f.; MM, VGT, s.vv.) (AS)
(κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), to grind: [[r:MAT.24.41|Mat 24:41]], [[r:LUK.17.35|Luk 17:35]].† (AS)

G0230.kjv: indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very

G0231.strongs: a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher
senses: ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ (ἅλς, the sea) a fisherman: [[r:MAT.4.18|Mat 4:18, 19]], [[r:MRK.1.16|Mrk 1:16, 17]], [[r:LUK.5.2|Luk 5:2]] (AS)

G0232.strongs: to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish

G0235.forms: ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146)
G0235.strongs: properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations)
G0235.kjv: and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet
senses: adversative particle, stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. [[r:ROM.3.31|Rom 3:31]]);

opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ)... ἀ., [[r:MAT.5.15|Mat 5:15, 17]] [[r:MRK.5.39|Mrk 5:39]], [[r:JHN.7.16|Jhn 7:16]], al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ... ἀ., not so much... as, [[r:MRK.9.37|Mrk 9:37]], [[r:MAT.10.20|Mat 10:20]], [[r:JHN.12.44|Jhn 12:44]], al.; with ellipse of the negation, [[r:MAT.11.7|Mat 11:7-9]], [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]], [[r:1CO.3.6|1Co 3:6 6:11 7:7]], [[r:2CO.7.1|2Co 7:1]], [[r:GAL.2.3|Gal 2:3]], al.; in opposition to a foregoing pos. sentence, ἀ. οὐ, [[r:MAT.24.6|Mat 24:6]], [[r:1CO.10.23|1Co 10:23]]; οὐ μόνον... ἀ. καί, [[r:JHN.5.18|Jhn 5:18]], [[r:ROM.1.32|Rom 1:32]], al.; elliptically, after a negation, ἀ. ἵνα, [[r:MRK.14.49|Mrk 14:49]], [[r:JHN.1.8|Jhn 1:8 9:3]], al.; = εἰ μή (Bl., §77, 13; M, Pr., 241; but cf. WM, §iii, 10), [[r:MAT.20.23|Mat 20:23]], [[r:MRK.4.22|Mrk 4:22]].

Without previous negation, to express opposition, interruption, transition, etc., but: [[r:JHN.16.20|Jhn 16:20 12:27]], [[r:GAL.2.14|Gal 2:14]]; before commands or requests, [[r:ACT.10.20|Act 10:20 26:16]], [[r:MAT.9.18|Mat 9:18]], [[r:MRK.9.22|Mrk 9:22]], al.; to introduce an accessory idea, [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11]]; in the apodosis after a condition or concession with εἰ, ἐάν, εἴπερ, yet, still, at least, [[r:MRK.14.29|Mrk 14:29]], [[r:1CO.9.2|1Co 9:2]], [[r:2CO.4.16|2Co 4:16]], [[r:COL.2.5|Col 2:5]], al.; after μέν, [[r:ACT.4.17|Act 4:17]], [[r:ROM.14.20|Rom 14:20]], [[r:1CO.14.17|1Co 14:17]]; giving emphasis to the following clause, ἀλλ᾽ ἔρχεται ὥρα, yea, etc., [[r:JHN.16.2|Jhn 16:2]]; so with neg., ἀλλ᾽ οὐδέ, nay, nor yet, [[r:LUK.23.15|Luk 23:15.]]

Joined with other particles (a practice which increases in late writers; Simcox, LNT, 166), ἀ. γε, yet at least, [[r:LUK.24.21|Luk 24:21]], [[r:1CO.9.2|1Co 9:2]]; ἄ ἤ., save only, except, [[r:LUK.12.51|Luk 12:51]], [[r:2CO.1.13|2Co 1:13]]; ἀ. μὲν οὖν, [[r:PHP.3.8|Php 3:8]] (on this usage, see MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, [[r:PSA.106.20|Psa 106:20]]) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]] (cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0238.kjv: be an allegory (the Greek word itself)

G0239.strongs: praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation
senses: ἁλληλουιά (Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), hallelujah, alleluia: [[r:REV.19.1|Rev 19:1, 3-4 19:6]].† (AS)

G0240.forms: ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron.
G0240.kjv: each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with or)

senses: (ἄλλος, γένος), of another race, a foreigner ( = ἀλλόφυλος; Cremer, 150; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:LUK.17.18|Luk 17:18.]]† (AS)

G0242.root: middle voice of apparently a primary verb
senses: ἅλλομαι to leap: [[r:ACT.3.8|Act 3:8 14:10]]; of water, to spring up, [[r:JHN.4.14|Jhn 4:14]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

other, another: absol., [[r:MAT.20.3|Mat 20:3]], al.; ἄ. δέ, [[r:1CO.3.10|1Co 3:10 12:8]]; pl., [[r:MRK.6.15|Mrk 6:15]]; attached to a noun, [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12 4:21]], al.; with art., ὁ ἄ., the other, [[r:MAT.5.39|Mat 5:39]], [[r:JHN.19.32|Jhn 19:32]] (Bl., §47, 8); οἱ ἄ., the others, the rest, [[r:JHN.20.25|Jhn 20:25]], [[r:1CO.14.29|1Co 14:29]]; ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους (BL, §48, 10), [[r:ACT.2.12|Act 2:12]]; ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ (Bl., §77, 13), [[r:LUK.12.51|Luk 12:51]]; before πλήν, [[r:MRK.12.32|Mrk 12:32]]; εἰ μή, [[r:JHN.6.22|Jhn 6:22]]; παρά with accusative, [[r:1CO.3.11|1Co 3:11.]] SYN.: ἕτερος, which see ἄ. denotes numerical, ἕ. qualitative difference (Cremer, 89). ἄ. generally "denotes simply distinction of individuals, ἕ. involves the secondary idea of difference in kind" (see Lft., Meyer, Ramsay, on [[r:GAL.1.6|Gal 1:6]], 7; Tr., Syn., §xcv; BL, §51, 6; M, Pr., 79f., 246; MM, VGT, s.vv.). As to whether the distinction can be maintained in [[r:1CO.12.8|1Co 12:8, 10]] see ICC, in l., and on [[r:HEB.11.35|Heb 11:35]]f., see Westc, in l. (AS)

G0244.strongs: overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs)
senses: ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ one who meddles in things alien to his calling: [[r:1PE.4.15|1Pe 4:15]] (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0245.strongs: another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile
senses: be-longing to another, not one's own (opposite to ἴδιος): [[r:LUK.16.12|Luk 16:12]], [[r:ROM.14.4|Rom 14:4 15:20]] (Field, Notes, 165 f.), [[r:2CO.10.15|2Co 10:15-16]], [[r:1TI.5.22|1Ti 5:22]], [[r:HEB.9.25|Heb 9:25]].
foreign, strange, alien (opposite to οἰκεῖος; see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:MAT.17.25|Mat 17:25-26]], [[r:JHN.10.5|Jhn 10:5]], [[r:ACT.7.6|Act 7:6]], [[r:HEB.11.9|Heb 11:9, 34]].† (AS)
(ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), foreign, of another race (MM, VGT, see word); as opposite to a Jew, a Gentile: [[r:ACT.10.28|Act 10:28.]]† (AS)
(ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, VGT, see word), to thresh: [[r:1CO.9.9|1Co 9:9 9:13]]; [[r:1TI.5.18|1Ti 5:18]].† (AS)
the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): [[r:JHN.19.39|Jhn 19:39.]]† (AS)

G0253.root: comparative of a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and [[w:G3077]]

G0255.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and the base of [[w:G3081]]

G0257.strongs: a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed)
senses: (for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, VGT, see word), ἡ, a threshing floor: [[r:MAT.3.12|Mat 3:12]], [[r:LUK.3.17|Luk 3:17]] (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).† (AS)

G0258.strongs: a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person

G0260.strongs: properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association
senses: ἅμα adv., at once (Lat. simul): [[r:ACT.24.26|Act 24:26 27:40]], [[r:ROM.3.12|Rom 3:12]] (one and all = יַחַד, [[r:PSA.14.3|Psa 14:3]]), [[r:COL.4.3|Col 4:3]], [[r:1TI.5.13|1Ti 5:13]], Phm 22; before σύν, [[r:1TH.4.17|1Th 4:17 5:10]]; as prep. with dative, together with: [[r:MAT.13.29|Mat 13:29]] (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: [[r:MAT.20.1|Mat 20:1.]]† (AS)
(μανθάνω), unlearned, ignorant: [[r:2PE.3.16|2Pe 3:16]] (on the rareness of this word, see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0263.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G3133]]
senses: (μαραίνομαι), un­fading (whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): [[r:1PE.1.4|1Pe 1:4]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0264.root: perhaps from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and the base of [[w:G3313]]
G0264.strongs: properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin
G0264.kjv: for your faults, offend, sin, trespass
senses: to miss the mark (Hom., Æsch., al.), hence metaphorically (Hom., al.), to err, do wrong

(ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., Notes, 273), a sinful deed, a sin: [[r:MRK.3.28|Mrk 3:28-29]], [[r:ROM.3.25|Rom 3:25]], [[r:1CO.6.18|1Co 6:18]], [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9]], WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (DCG, i, 788a), [[r:MRK.3.29|Mrk 3:29]] (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., Syn., § lxvi; DB, iv, 532; DCG, l.with; Westc, Eph., 165 f.) (AS)
(ἁμαρτάνω, which see), prop. a missing the mark; in cl. (see reff. to CR in MM, VGT, see word);
more freq., from Æsch. down, a fault, failure. In NT (as LXX) always in ethical sense;

as a principle and quality of action, = τὸ ἁμαρτάνειν, a sinning, sin: [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12, 13 20]]; ὑφ᾽ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι, [[r:ROM.3.9|Rom 3:9]]; ἐπιμένειν, [[r:ROM.6.1|Rom 6:1]]; ἀποθνήσκειν, νεκρὸν εἶναι τῇ ἁ., [[r:ROM.6.2|Rom 6:2, 11]]; τὴν ἀ. γινώσκειν, [[r:ROM.7.7|Rom 7:7]]; σῶμα τῆς ἁ., [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]]; ἀπάτη τῆς ἁ., [[r:HEB.3.13|Heb 3:13]]; personified as a ruling principle, ἁ. βασιλεύει, κυριεύει, etc., [[r:ROM.5.21|Rom 5:21]] 6:12, 14 7:17, 20; δουλεύειν, [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]]; δοῦλος τῆς ἁ., ib. 17; νόμος τῆς ἁ., [[r:ROM.7.23|Rom 7:23 8:2]]; δύναμις τῆς ἁ., [[r:1CO.15.56|1Co 15:56]] (cf. [[r:GEN.4.7|Gen 4:7]]).

As a generic term (disting. fr. the specific terms ἁμάρτημα, which see, etc.) for concrete wrongdoing, violation of the divine law, sin: [[r:JHN.8.46|Jhn 8:46]], [[r:JAS.1.15|Jas 1:15]], al.; ποιεῖν (τὴν) ἁ., [[r:JHN.8.34|Jhn 8:34]], [[r:2CO.11.7|2Co 11:7]], [[r:1JN.3.8|1Jn 3:8]]; εἴχειν ἁ., [[r:JHN.9.41|Jhn 9:41 15:22, 24 19:11]], [[r:1JN.1.8|1Jn 1:8]]; in pl. ἁμαρτίαι, sin in the aggregate, [[r:1TH.2.16|1Th 2:16]] (see Milligan, in l.); ποιεῖν ἁμαρτίας, [[r:JAS.5.15|Jas 5:15]]; πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν, [[r:JAS.5.20|Jas 5:20]], [[r:1PET.4.8|1Pe 4:8]]; ἄφεσις ἁμαρτιῶν, [[r:MAT.26.28|Mat 26:28]], [[r:MRK.1.4|Mrk 1:4]], al.; ἐν ἁμαρτίαις εἶναι, [[r:1CO.15.17|1Co 15:17]]; collectively, αἴρειν τὴν ἁ. τ. κόσμου, [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29]]; ἀποθνήσκειν ἐν τῇ ἁ., [[r:JHN.8.21|Jhn 8:21.]]
= ἁμάρτημα, a sinful deed, a sin: [[r:MAT.12.31|Mat 12:31]], [[r:ACT.7.60|Act 7:60]], [[r:1JN.5.16|1Jn 5:16]]. SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα. (AS)

G0267.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a form of [[w:G3144]]

senses: (ἁμαρτάνω), sinful, a sinner: of all men, [[r:1TI.1.15|1Ti 1:15]]; of those especially wicked, [[r:1TI.1.9|1Ti 1:9]], [[r:1PE.4.18|1Pe 4:18]]; p1., [[r:MAT.9.10|Mat 9:10-13 11:19 26:45]], al. (see MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 102, 634) (AS)
abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: [[r:1TI.3.3|1Ti 3:3]], [[r:TIT.3.2|Tit 3:2]].† (AS)

G0270.strongs: properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap

G0271.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3184]]
senses: (accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) amethyst, a purple quartz: [[r:REV.21.20|Rev 21:20.]]† (AS)

G0272.kjv: make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard
senses: absol., to be careless, not to care: [[r:MAT.22.5|Mat 22:5]];
with genitive, to be careless of, to neglect: [[r:1TI.4.14|1Ti 4:14]], [[r:HEB.2.3|Heb 2:3 8:9]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0273.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3201]]
senses: ἄ-μεμπτος, -ον (μέμφομσι), blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, Th., I, 3:13; cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[r:LUK.1.6|Luk 1:6]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15 3:6]], [[r:1TH.3.13|1Th 3:13]] (WH, mg., -ως) [[r:HEB.8.7|Heb 8:7.]]† SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., Syn., § ciii) (AS)
ἀ-μέμπτως, adv. (ἄμεμπτος), blamelessly (Lft., Notes, 28, 89; MM, VGT, see word -ος): [[r:1TH.2.10|1Th 2:10 3:13]] WH mg., 5:23.† (AS)
(μέριμνα), free from anxiety or care: [[r:MAT.28.14|Mat 28:14]], [[r:1CO.7.32|1Co 7:32]] (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0276.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3346]]
senses: ἀ-μετάθετος, -ον (μετατίθημι), immutable: [[r:HEB.6.18|Heb 6:18]]; as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, [[r:HEB.6.17|Heb 6:17]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0277.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3334]]

G0278.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G3338]]
G0278.kjv: without repentance, not to be repented of

G0279.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G3340]]
senses: = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
(μέτρον), without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, [[r:2CO.10.13|2Co 10:13 10:15]]† (AS)

G0281.forms: ἀμήν, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, to prop. ni., be firm)
G0281.strongs: properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it)
senses: in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another (Nu, Ne, etc., ll. with): ὁ ἀ., [[r:1CO.14.16|1Co 14:16]];

similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise: [[r:ROM.1.25|Rom 1:25 15:33]], [[r:GAL.1.5|Gal 1:5]], [[r:1TI.1.17|1Ti 1:17]]; (with) in the Gospels, exclusively, introducing solemn statements of our Lord, truly, verily: [[r:MAT.5.18|Mat 5:18, 26]] [[r:MRK.3.28|Mrk 3:28]] (see Swete, in l.), [[r:LUK.4.24|Luk 4:24]], al.; ἀ. ἀ., always in [[r:JHN.1.52|Jhn 1:52 3:3 5:19]], al.; τὸ ναί, καὶ... τὸ ἀ., [[r:2CO.1.20|2Co 1:20]] (on usage in π., see MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
(μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ. of one without recorded genealogy, [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0283.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3392]]
senses: ἀ-μίαντος, -ον (μιαίνω), undefiled, free from contamination (in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, VGT, see word): [[r:HEB.7.26|Heb 7:26 13:4]], [[r:1PE.1.4|1Pe 1:4]], [[r:JAS.1.27|Jas 1:27]].† SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784) (AS)
a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29, 36]], [[r:ACT.8.32|Act 8:32]]" (LXX), [[r:1PE.1.19|1Pe 1:19]] (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).† (AS)
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); requital, recompense: [[r:1TI.5.4|1Ti 5:4]] (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0288.root: probably from the base of [[w:G0297]] and that of [[w:G0257]]
G0288.strongs: a vine (as coiling about a support)
senses: vine: [[r:MAT.26.29|Mat 26:29]], [[r:MRK.14.25|Mrk 14:25]], [[r:LUK.22.18|Luk 22:18]] [[r:JAS.3.12|Jas 3:12]]; figuratively, of Christ, [[r:JHN.15.1|Jhn 15:1, 4-5]]; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): [[r:REV.14.18|Rev 14:18-19.]]† (AS)

(ἄμπελος), a vineyard: [[r:MAT.20.1|Mat 20:1]] ff. [[r:MAT.21.28|Mat 21:28]] ff, [[r:LUK.13.6|Luk 13:6 20:9]] ff., [[r:1CO.9.7|1Co 9:7]]. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.) (AS)

G0292.root: middle voice of a primary verb
G0292.strongs: to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect
senses: to requite; (with) = act., to defend, assist (Isa, l.with): with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.7.24|Act 7:24]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0293.root: from a compound of the base of [[w:G0297]] and [[w:G0906]]
G0293.strongs: a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish)
senses: (ἀμφιβάλλω), something thrown around, as a garment; spec., a casting-net: [[r:MAT.4.18|Mat 4:18.]]† (AS)

G0294.root: from the base of [[w:G0297]] and ἕννυμι (to invest)

G0295.strongs: a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia
senses: Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it: [[r:ACT.17.1|Act 17:1.]]† (AS)
(ἀμφί ὁδός), prop., a road around anything (RV, the open street): [[r:MRK.11.4|Mrk 11:4]], [[r:ACT.19.28|Act 19:28]], WH, mg.† (AS)
ἀμφότεροι, -αι, -α (replaces ἄμφω in κοινή, V. M, Pr., 57; used of more than two, Pr., 80; MM, VGT, see word), both of two: [[r:MAT.9.17|Mat 9:17]], al. (AS)

G0298.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G3469]]

G0299.kjv: without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable
senses: ἄ-μωμος, -ον (μῶμος, which see),; of sacrificial victims, without blemish: of Christ, [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]], [[r:1PE.1.19|1Pe 1:19]]; etbically, unblemished, faultless: [[r:EPH.1.4|Eph 1:4 5:27]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]], [[r:COL.1.22|Col 1:22]], Ju 24, [[r:REV.14.5|Rev 14:5]] (Cremer, 425, 788; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος (AS)
variant for ἅλας (which see): [[r:MRK.9.49|Mrk 9:49]], Rec. WH, mg., R, mg.† (AS)
